# SVB - Santez Vous Bien

> Official facts and canonical links for Studio SVB in Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine, France.

Last updated: 2026-08-20
Canonical website: https://studiosvb.com/

## Identity

- Brand: SVB
- Meaning of SVB: Santez Vous Bien
- Public studio name: Studio SVB
- Business: two small-group sports and coaching studios in Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine
- Phone: +33 7 44 91 91 55
- Email: hello@studiosvb.fr
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/svb.officiel/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61569485866457

SVB does not currently offer massage or wellness-treatment services.

## Locations

### Studio de pilates Reformer - SVB

- Alternate location name: SVB - Cours des Lavandieres
- Address: 40 Cours des Lavandieres, 93400 Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine, France
- Main activities: Pilates Reformer, Crossformer, Pilates mat classes and Yoga
- Location page: https://studiosvb.com/studio-cours-des-lavandieres
- Official Google Maps profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=5013071026965844982
- Google rating verified on 2026-08-20: 5.0/5 from 88 reviews

Reception hours:

- Monday: 10:30-13:45 and 16:30-21:00
- Tuesday: 10:30-14:30 and 16:30-21:15
- Wednesday: 10:30-13:30 and 16:30-21:15
- Thursday: 11:00-14:30 and 17:00-20:30
- Friday: 10:30-14:30 and 16:30-20:15
- Saturday: 08:45-14:00 and 15:00-18:45
- Sunday: 09:45-13:45 and 14:45-17:45

Classes may start outside reception hours. Use the current online schedule.

### SVB - Studio de coaching sportif & Bootcamp

- Alternate location name: SVB - Parc des Docks
- Address: 6 Mail Andre Breton, 93400 Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine, France
- Main activities: coaching, Cross Training, Boxe Anglaise, Afrodance and children's sport classes

Together, the two official Google Business Profiles have 170 reviews. Review counts may increase after the verification date above; the two Google Maps profiles are authoritative.

## Booking and pricing

- Trial class: EUR 30
- The full EUR 30 is deducted from the first subscription payment when a member subscribes within 7 days of the trial.
- A booked class can be cancelled up to 1 hour before it starts, subject to the current terms.
- Current memberships and prices: https://studiosvb.com/tarifs
- Current schedule: https://studiosvb.com/studio
- Trial booking: https://studiosvb.com/reserver

Prices and schedules can change. The canonical pricing and schedule pages above are authoritative.
